title: 17. The Little Book That Beats the Market - Joel Greenblatt

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this episode of Compounding Interest, we review Joel Greenblatt’s investment classic, The Little Book That Beats the Market.
reader_summary.overview: In this episode of Compounding Interest, we review Joel Greenblatt’s investment classic, The Little Book That Beats the Market. Greenblatt, a successful hedge fund manager and professor, outlines a "magic formula" designed to help individual investors achieve market-beating returns with low risk. The strategy is centered on two key metrics: earnings yield and return on capital.

key_points.text: By ranking companies based on these factors, the formula identifies high-quality businesses selling at bargain prices.
We explore the logic behind these concepts and examine the formula’s historical performance.
However, successful implementation requires more than just following a list; it demands the discipline to maintain a long-term perspective.
